caption: The video captures a tranquil forest stream framed by dense, sunlit summer foliage on both banks, with a pale sky glowing through a gap in the canopy. The calm foreground water mirrors the trees and sky, while a light-colored rock breaks the surface left of center and a fallen log rests along the right bank. Out-of-focus lens-flare dots, green upper-left and orange mid-left, stay fixed over the scene. The camera holds still throughout, keeping the solid elements in fixed positions. The only visible motion is the gentle, continuous shimmer of the water's surface, where the reflected tree trunks and the bright sky patch waver and deform subtly from moment to moment. This faint rippling is already underway in the first frame and persists through the last, neither originating nor resolving within the clip. No moving object, animal, or person enters the view, and lighting and color remain constant.
